title: Nearest Black Vertex
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 2000; N-1 \leq M \leq \min\lbrace N(N-1)/2, 2000 \rbrace; 1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N; 0 \leq K \leq N; 1 \leq p_1 \lt p_2 \lt \cdots \lt p_K \leq N; 0 \leq d_i \leq N; The given graph is simple and connected.; All values in the input are integers.
